rule.everything_else: the published train.sh values: local_epoch=10, batch=128, lr=1e-2 SGD, momentum=0, weight_decay=0, MultiStepLR([5,10], 0.1), join_ratio=1, gmm_pl=1, eta_clustering=0, train_mode=US, model=c2fpl_XD (the repo's 1024-d head, matching our feature width)
rule.selection_metric: frame_ROC_AUC (CLAP's own paper reports frame-level ROC-AUC)
rule.scope: one value per dataset; the same value is then used for the `central` variant and for all three seeds
rule.test_calls: one per dataset, after the selected values are written into run_record.json
